## Invitations

A total of 1863 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Of those invited, 1307 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 70.2. This provides a clear summary of participation following the invitation process. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, which should be considered when reviewing outreach activity and planning future communications.

The figures indicate that most invited people did not require additional contact beyond the initial invitation. The attendance result nevertheless shows substantial engagement with the offer extended to the community.

## Contact

SMS communication was used alongside the invitations. A total of 1587 invitations were sent with an SMS, and 1587 people received a reminder message. The matching figures show the recorded volume for both forms of contact.

These results are provided for routine monitoring of outreach activity and attendance. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
